helpPanel.notice: Help keeps what you search and the problems you report, with the screen name, so Admin can answer and improve the ERP. It reads only what your own rights allow and never changes data.
helpPanel.intro: Search how to do a task, see why something was refused, or tell Admin about a problem.
helpPanel.accessNote: Access is given only by Admin. Tell Admin which work you need to do and for how long; Admin can give a special permission for a set time.
helpPanel.noRulePage: There is no help page for this rule yet. Report the problem and Admin will explain.
helpPanel.errorNotFound: This reference is not among your errors. Check the code, or report the problem with it.
helpPanel.pageMissing: This help page is not available.
helpPanel.noResults: Nothing found. Try other words, or report the problem.
helpPanel.noScreenPage: No help page for this screen yet. Search above, or report a problem.

rules.describe: Say in a few words what happened (at least 5 letters).
